description:
One spring day when the cherry blossoms were in full bloom. So-Seol confesses his long-held feelings to Hong-An. However, Hong-An responds by setting fire to So-Seol’s family home, then vanishes without a trace. After wandering for seven years in search of him, what appears before So-Seol is Yeo-An, who is identical in every way, from his breath and smile to his gait, but whose only difference is the color of his eyes. A tense standoff ensues between So-Seol, who is convinced that Hong-An and Yeo-An are the same person, and Yeo-An, who steadfastly denies it...

Will So-Seol, finally hear the answer to the feelings he confessed that day?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated) 

 *Note:
\- The eighth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.
\- Includes one extra chapter.*
